quantity.name: constant volumetric heat-source parameter recovered from temperature measurements

reference.source: Version-matched MOOSE constant_heat_source optimization seed; the forward source is q and the four declared temperatures are generated at q=1000.
reference.derivation: Linearity of the steady conduction problem makes the reporter objective strictly convex in q; the shipped measurement vector is the q=1000 solution.

tolerance.rationale: Declared for the PDE inverse rebuild; objective residual and adjoint-gradient consistency are reported separately.

convergence.note: Optimization convergence is assessed by recovered q, objective residual, and adjoint gradient for the fixed measurement set.
